title: Onboarded model runtime integration sanity checks for streaming + external-hook calls
creator: Nora Chen
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight sanity and regression harness to validate that newly onboarded models behave correctly when used with streaming outputs + external tool/function hooks. This ticket covers the test design, implementation of probes, a small CI job that runs against pinned snapshots of new models, and publishing a short performance compatibility profile used by release notes and the model catalog.

Scope:
- Streaming protocol conformance (chunk ordering, end-of-stream markers, chunk loss/error semantics)
- Function/tool-call encoding/roundtrip (structured payloads, function-name fidelity, argument truncation)
- Backpressure and KV-cache compatibility during long-lived streams
- Edge cases: mid-stream tool-attach, reconnects, multi-tool interleaving

Non-goals: full-scale long-tail stress testing (handled by existing regression suite), performance microbenchmarks for every input size (separate perf job).
acceptance_criteria:
1) CI smoke job runs against a model snapshot and returns pass/fail with explicit reasons.
2) No regressions in chunk order or toolcall payload fidelity across three model families for the last two onboarding waves.
3) A short published compatibility profile (CSV/JSON) showing pass/fail + P50/P95 latency for streaming+toolcall paths attached to the model catalog.
4) Failure modes enumerated in the runbook with remediation steps and a linked GH issue template for follow-ups.
test_plan:
- Create harness: small harness binary that opens a streaming session, emits sequences that trigger tool-calls mid-stream, and validates the reconstructed function invocation on the consumer side.
- Test vectors: canonical prompt + 12 edge cases (e.g., nested JSON, multi-part tool args, intentional truncation, reconnect after error).
- Run types: quick CI smoke (3 models, 3 vectors each), nightly extended (10 models, full vector set).
- Output: structured test report (status, diff of expected vs observed tool payload, token-level timeline).
metrics:
- Stream ordering violations (count per 1k requests)
- Toolcall payload truncation rate
- Function name mismatch rate
- Mean time to first valid toolcall (ms)
- P50/P95 end-to-end latency for streaming+toolcall path
- Regression delta vs previous snapshot (percent increase in errors)
runbook:
- If CI smoke fails: 1) check model snapshot hash and version pin; 2) run harness locally against a debug build with --verbose to collect chunk traces; 3) if chunk reordering observed, escalate to runtime team and open ENG ticket with attached trace.
- Common fixes: adjust handshake window, add explicit stream-flush after tool payload, or pin model variant with known streaming fixes.
- Communication: notify model-onboarding Slack channel + post summary in #runtime-incidents when high-severity failure ( > 1% toolcall loss).
